subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Will maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative OpenAI SDK unit coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI code-less encrypted_content decrypt error, or require an organic after-fix Grok capture?
rationale: The external PR lacks after-fix real setup proof, but the contributor argues the exact provider-side rotation error cannot be forced without waiting for xAI to rotate a stored blob.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the source-level proof and prior production logs for this provider-side trigger, then land after exact-head checks stay green.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future xAI rotation produces redacted logs showing the stripped retry succeeds in a real gateway run.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold or close this branch if maintainers decide the proof gap is too large for a provider transport change.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the source-level proof and prior production logs for this provider-side trigger, then land after exact-head checks stay green.
